face_convention: N/E/S/W are the cube's side contacts with the module turned exactly as drawn in its raw_orig_icon (rotation 0).

elements.name: block_001

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r2k2-o (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Icon has the same fan-out as block_003 (lead to W, body, then lines from the far lead to N, E and S), and block_003's pinout is confirmed as a W–E resistor with E wired to N and S. So this is very likely the same T topology, and the catalogue's plain W–E span is incomplete.

elements.name: block_002

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r12k-a (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Read the way block_003's confirmed icon reads (every line that reaches the rim is a contact), this icon shows a plain wire straight across W–E with the resistor hanging off it down to the bottom rim — i.e. W and E joined, resistor from that node to S. Doesn't match the catalogue's N–E hypothesis in this orientation; needs confirming.

elements.name: block_003
elements.notes: Electrically W is one node and N/E/S are one node, with the resistor between them, so it can be used straight through (W–E) or as a corner (W–N, W–S). The small ring on a stem under the resistor body is unexplained; blocks 004 and 006 have one too, so it isn't what tells the two 68 кОм modules apart. The kit's other 68 кОм module is block_004, drawn differently, so num_in_kit = 1.

elements.name: block_004
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 1. Second 68 кОм module (block_003 is the first); resistor drawn on a diagonal, with a small ring. Probably catalogue.ts:r68k-a.

elements.name: block_005
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 2. First of two 680 кОм modules; resistor drawn straight W–E like block_003. Probably catalogue.ts:r680k-o.

elements.name: block_006
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 3. Second 680 кОм module; plain W–E line with the resistor on a diagonal below it, like block_002, plus a small ring. Probably catalogue.ts:r680k-a.

elements.name: block_007
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 4. First of two 1 МОм modules; drawn like block_004 without the ring. Probably catalogue.ts:r1m-a.

elements.name: block_008
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 5. Second 1 МОм module; resistor drawn straight W–E with one diagonal line. Probably catalogue.ts:r1m-o.

elements.name: block_009
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 1. First of three 0,01 мкФ modules; capacitor drawn straight W–E with two diagonal lines, like block_003. Probably catalogue.ts:c10n-o.

elements.name: block_010
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic tubular type KT-1, temperature group N70, 680 pF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 2. Drawn unlike the others: a W–E line that dips around the centre and a line straight from top to bottom. An ink blot, probably scan damage, covers the upper right of the icon and could hide a line there. Probably catalogue.ts:c680p-a.

elements.name: block_011
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic tubular type KT-1, temperature group N70, 3300 pF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 3. Capacitor drawn straight W–E with one diagonal line up to the rim, like block_008. Probably catalogue.ts:c3n3-o.

elements.name: block_012
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 4. Second 0,01 мкФ module; capacitor drawn straight W–E with one diagonal line up to the rim, plus a small ring. Row order says catalogue.ts:c10n-a, but that entry is 'adjacent' while this is drawn like the straight-through ones, so either the order mapping or the catalogue is wrong here.

elements.name: block_013
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 5. Third 0,01 мкФ module; capacitor drawn straight W–E with one diagonal line down to the rim. The bottom of the circle is cut off by the edge of the scan. Probably catalogue.ts:c10n-o2.
